svg.title: How the script talks to the agent
svg.desc: Two lanes side by side with a channel between them, and a strip of shared ground underneath. Left, the script, a slate lane: bash, run from your shell, where no hook runs. Five steps. One, set the stage: prisma migrate reset --force, then git switch -c ticket/18-slug; the guard refuses the reset to the agent, the script is yours. Two, start one process: kiro-cli chat --v3 --no-interactive --output-format stream-json --agent implementer --effort high --trust-workspace "/implement-unattended #18". Three, read the stream: tee to .ai-runs/18.events.jsonl, narrate, tee to .ai-runs/18.log; the screen shows [execute] pnpm check, [edit] a path, and the agent's words. Four, read the ground, not the chat: git status --short, stop if dirty; gh pr list --head; the exit status is printed, not trusted. Five, back to main; the next ticket is a new process. Right, the agent, an amber lane: kiro-cli chat, a fresh process, nothing from the last ticket. What it is given: implementer.json with allow for commit, push and pr create and deny for merge, close, gh api and kiro-cli; implementer.md, the brief; the saved prompt, which reads the implement-ticket skill; and the agent-guard hook, the same guard as lesson 5. What it does with nobody to ask: states the seams from the ticket's Seams line, red, green, pnpm check, commit, code-review against main, fix, push, gh pr create, and ends with the PR URL or a NO PR line. What it can't do: an ask is a deny, a denial is final, it never resets, merges or ticks a box, can't start kiro-cli and can't edit its own rules. What it leaves behind: commits on the branch, a pull request on GitHub, and its words only in the stream. Between the lanes, three channels. In, once, as arguments, from the script to the agent: a rulebook and one sentence, nothing else is ever sent. Out, continuously, on stdout, from the agent to the script: one JSON event per line, tool_call with the command or path, tool_call_update with the status, agent_message_chunk with the words, runFinished; stderr carries startup info and denials to the log. Never, crossed out: an answer. The script can't say yes; the agent file said it in advance, and the guard says no inside the session. Underneath, the shared ground: the checkout, where the branch and the commits are; the database, reset by the script and migrated by the agent; GitHub, where the pull request, CI and the AI review are. The script trusts the ground, not the conversation. A red strip: the eighth rule, pnpm implement:frontier is refused to every agent; the script runs the reset the guard refuses the agent, so the guard refuses the script to the agent.
svg.text: How the script talks to the agent
One process starts another. Everything between them is an argument, a stream, or the ground they share.
bash, run from your shell. No hook runs here.
The guard refuses the reset to the agent.
The script is yours, so it runs it.
Read the ground, not the chat
Exit status is printed, not trusted.
A pull request exists, or it doesn't.
Back to main. Next: a new process.
THE AGENT · kiro-cli chat · one fresh process
Nothing from the last ticket. Nobody at the keyboard.
What it does, with nobody to ask
Seams from the ticket's Seams: line, stated.
Red, green, pnpm check, commit with #18.
Ends with the PR URL, or NO PR: and why.
An ask is a deny: no one is there to answer.
A denial is final. It says so and stops.
Never resets, merges, closes, ticks a box.
Can't start kiro-cli. Can't edit its own rules.
Commits on the branch. A pull request on GitHub.
Its words: only in the stream, and so in the log.
The conversation itself: gone with the process.
OUT · stdout, one event per line
stderr: startup info, denials → the log
The agent file said it in advance,
and the guard says no inside.
THE GROUND THEY SHARE · what the script reads when the process ends
ticket/18-…, its commits, or a dirty tree
Reset by the script, migrated by the agent
The PR, Closes #18, CI, the AI review
The eighth rule: pnpm implement:frontier is refused to every agent. The script runs the reset the guard refuses the agent.
